However, Mr. Venkatesh, the manager, informed me that I was “too late” and insisted that my service could only be done the next day. This was both confusing and frustrating given my punctual arrival.

In addition to the scheduling issue, the service center suffers from severe parking problems, as clearly shown in the attached images. There was no staff available to guide customers on where to park, and the only instruction provided was to “park wherever space is available.” Such lack of organization and customer care made the entire experience even more inconvenient.

Overall, this was one of the worst customer service experiences I have encountered, and I believe significant improvements are urgently needed at this service center.
